pages.text: Lily of the Valley · Flower Drink$(br2)Brewed from the Lily of the Valley Tea Bag in a teapot with water; yields twelve cups.$(br2)$(br2)I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys.$(br2)— Song of Songs

pages.text: Releases a poison cloud when struck.$(br2)$(br2)Health Boost 2:15, Lingering Kiss 2:15
